school.name: Veritas Academy
school.overview: At Veritas Academy, students learn about the values of truth, dignity, and humanity.  We are a small post-secondary preparatory high school that focuses on igniting the talents of all students to perform at their full potential.  Our dedicated faculty and staff members support individual strengths so that students may set and accomplish goals.  We want students to be accepted to the college of their choice.  By participating in advanced-level real-world learning opportunities, internships, and volunteer work, students use their individuality and creativity to help others.  At Veritas, students receive a rigorous and well-rounded education so that they leave high school as active, civics-minded contributing members of society.
